Allegany and Garrett counties were hit hard by flooding – knocking out resources like power, water, and broadband.

In partnership with Maryland Broadband Cooperative Incorporated, we’re adding approximately 26 miles of fiber optic cable to underserved communities in Allegany and Garrett to help Marylanders get back on their feet.

The First Lady and I wish a Chag Pesach Sameach to the Jewish community here in Maryland.

The history of Passover – rooted in values of faith, freedom, and resilience – reminds us to continue our fight in overcoming darkness. May this season bring you strength, reflection, and a renewed sense of purpose.

DHS’s warehouse purchasing pause and review of past purchases is encouraging news. 

The federal government spent hundreds of millions in taxpayer money buying a warehouse near Hagerstown — without an environmental review and without public input. At the same time, they’ve slashed health care, cut food assistance, and denied aid for historic flooding in Western Maryland.

My top priority is keeping Marylanders safe. We will always work with the federal government to remove violent criminals, but

The current administration is doing irreparable harm, and they have to be held accountable and put in check.

Video

Maryland governors don’t normally attend Baltimore’s State of the City Address.

But the partnership I have with this city and this mayor is different. And it’s because we’ve decided to move together to achieve results for everyone that we are stronger as both a city AND as a state.

A leading brand in the food industry just got bigger.

Congrats to Maryland’s own @mccormickspices on their expansion!

Today, on Trans Day of Visibility, we celebrate the strength and contributions of trans Marylanders.

As many in the trans community face growing challenges and uncertainty, Maryland remains committed to dignity, safety, and belonging for all.

We will not tolerate discrimination or harm against our trans neighbors, friends, and family members because of their identity, and as long as I am governor, Maryland will be a safe haven for our trans community.
